description: v2.6: endDate filter widened to < DATE_ADD(endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY) - test_datetime is a DATETIME and the routes send date-only params, so a plain <= endDate collapsed same-day windows to midnight-only matches and silently dropped the final day of every multi-day range. Base dataset for the MOH 706 report over the order-grain flat_moh_706_report table (grain + raw facts only). Test slots carry raw values keyed by concept id: coded slots carry result_concept_id so the aggregate's = 703 positivity rules work, numeric slots carry result_numeric so banding and MAX/MIN work. The 0/1 flag columns mirror the aggregate indicator aliases so patient-list drill-downs filter rows. Register presentation (names, translation, layout) lives in lab-706-patient-list.json, translated through etl.concept_value_map at request time. v2.2: panel tests (CBC 1019, URINALYSIS 302, LIPID PANEL 1010) no longer rely on the order row's single raw result - member-aware flags probe etl.flat_moh_706_report_results by primary key (report_id[, member_concept_id]), one B-tree lookup per matching row, no grain change. fbc_hgb carries the HGB (21) member value for the Hb bands (previously the bands read the panel row's value, i.e. one arbitrary member). The *_with_members flags count standalone orders PLUS urinalysis-member occurrences - new aliases alongside the legacy ones pending counting-semantics sign-off; legacy aliases are unchanged. v2.3: reportable-concept expansion (electrolytes, tumour markers, proteins, glucose, taenia, sickling, reticulocyte, HB estimation, TPHA, ASOT, HIV 12019, VDRL 299 alongside 11868, bacteriology/cytology specimen counts); hiv is order-backed (status re-entries on encounter forms are not lab workload); hiv_new_diagnosis counts patients whose flat_hiv_summary_v15b enrollment_date (first diagnosis, enrollment location) falls in the reporting period; a static has-result filter drops rows where no test was actually done (panel parents survive through their member results). v2.3.1: with_members flags for the microscopy analytes and a total_urine_microscopy flag, so the urine-analysis rows count panel members (the legacy standalone-only aliases stay for comparability); urine_s_haematobium still has no source concept. v2.4: reference-range banding - every numeric slot gains _low/_high flags (tumour markers high-only) banded against etl.reference_ranges (seeded from amrs.concept_numeric; NULL bounds read 0) - see MOH-706-REFERENCE-RANGE-BANDING-PLAN.md. v2.5: additional reportable concepts (1.10 bacteria 53247, 2.24/2.26 tumour markers CA 15-3 53248 / CA 125 53249 with max/min/total + high-only banding, 4.8 coagulation profile 53250 counted through member results like the panels, 5.2-5.8 bacteriology specimens 53311-53315, 5.12-5.28 epidemic-prone organisms 53269/53270/53316/53279-53288 with positive_ = result_concept_id 703, 6.4-6.25 histology/cytology specimen sites 53289-53307, 7.8 hepatitis A 53309); coded slots carry result_concept_id and every count flag uses the 4-way has-result check so text/numeric answers still count; 5.15 V. cholerae O139 shares concept 53316 with 5.14 and has no register line until its own concept exists - see moh-706-additional-concepts-plan.md in the etl repo. v2.7: lipid analytes (total cholesterol, triglycerides, LDL) get member-aware *_with_members value slots and flags - standalone value COALESCEd with the LIPID PANEL (1010) member value - so Total/Low/High count panel-recorded results, not just standalone orders; the existing low/high banding flags read the same combined value. v2.8: TB SMEAR (307) slot - positivity is any non-negative coded answer (scanty and graded positives carry their own codes, not 703). v2.9: haematology 4.3 Hemoglobin A1c (6126) - numeric slot hba1c plus total_hba1c and the register bands hba1c_pre_diabetes (5.7 <= v < 6.5) and hba1c_diabetes (v >= 6.5, ADA cutoffs, matching the fbc_hb_*/cd4 fixed-band precedent rather than the lab reference interval) for the register row's Total Exam / Pre-diabetes / Diabetes columns. Also 1.5 urine microscopy - new urine_microscopy (1986) slot; total_urine_microscopy now counts 1986 results alongside 1984/1985/15086/15084 (both standalone orders and urinalysis-panel members, so the count rises once 1986 rows exist - historical orders need one build backfill); positive_urine_microscopy flags any of those concepts coded POSITIVE (703). Also 2.3 renal function test (6898) - renal_function_test numeric slot and total_renal_function_test via the 4-way has-result check so any answer datatype counts (the register row asks for Total tests only; its Low/High cells stay unwired). Also the 2.3 RENAL FUNCTION TEST panel (6898): results are grouped under a valueless 6898 obs head, so the nested analyte rows (2.4 Creatinine 790, 2.5 Urea 857, 2.6 Sodium 1132, 2.7 Potassium 1133, 2.8 Chlorides 1134) read 0 for panel-recorded tests - their value slots now COALESCE the standalone value with the 6898-panel member value (lipid v2.7 pattern), the _low/_high flags band that same combined value, and the total_ flags count standalone orders OR 6898 member results so register numbers and drill-down filters stay consistent; total_renal_function_test counts a 6898 row with its own result OR any member result (panel-total pattern). Counts for these analytes rise to include panel-recorded results - release note. The ETL admits 6898 as a panel head regardless of the dictionary is_set flag (a childless admission contributes no edges); member capture flows through concept_set_map + flat_moh_706_report_results as for CBC/urinalysis. Also 2.8 liver function test (953) - datatype unused elsewhere in the codebase, so the liver_function_test slot carries COALESCE(result_concept_id, result_numeric) (tb_culture precedent) and total_liver_function_test uses the 4-way has-result check plus any member result, 953 being treated as a probable panel like 6898 (its member analytes 653/654/655/1297/717/785/848 are already reportable; the ETL admits 953 as a head the same way). Also stool examination (53310) - same datatype-unknown treatment (COALESCE slot, 4-way total plus any member result, ETL head admission alongside 6898/953) for the parasitology register row; the owner correction replaces 304, which was erroneously tied to 5.16 CSF in the dictionary and is not stool. positive_stool_examination is presence of the parasite: the row's own answer coded POSITIVE (703) or any member result coded POSITIVE (owner 2026-10-27); Total Exam counts stool tests with a recorded result per the register-wide has-result convention.
